tagline: Leading PCTC operator enabling global automotive trade with sustainable roll-on/roll-off shipping solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The volume transported (CBM) is the primary operational and financial driver for Höegh Autoliners, directly reflecting demand from automotive manufacturers and the ability to capture Asian export flows, particularly from China.

kpis.name: Volume transported (CBM)
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of goods transported measured in cubic meters.
kpis.description: The volume transported reached 3.9 million CBM in Q4 2025, up 12% year-on-year, supported by Chinese and European demand.
kpis.signal: Strong volume growth despite a complex environment.

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the transportation of automotive vehicles.
kpis.description: Annual revenue amounted to $1,426 million in 2025, up 4% compared to 2024, driven by volumes and contractual demand.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before depreciation and amortization, adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA for 2025 amounted to $621 million, down 10.8% compared to 2024 ($696 million), due to lower freight rates and two fewer vessels in service.
kpis.signal: EBITDA decline linked to lower rates and fleet adjustments.

kpis.name: Net profit after tax
kpis.explanation: Profit after taxes and financial expenses for the period.
kpis.description: Net profit after tax for 2025 was $513 million, down 17.3% compared to 2024 ($620 million), impacted by lower gains on vessel disposals ($61 million in 2025 vs $52 million in 2024).
kpis.signal: Net profit decline despite revenue growth.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Spending on vessel acquisitions and technical upgrades, including down payments on newbuild vessels.
kpis.description: Capex for Q4 2025 amounted to $72 million, primarily for down payments on Aurora Class vessels and dry-docking expenses.
kpis.signal: High capex focused on new Aurora Class vessels.

kpis.name: Equity ratio
kpis.explanation: Proportion of equity in total balance sheet, a solvency indicator.
kpis.description: The equity ratio was 55% at end-2025, slightly down from 56% in 2024, reflecting a policy of fully distributing free cash flow to shareholders.

kpis.name: Contract revenue share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue linked to long-term contracts with automotive customers.
kpis.description: The share of contract-based activities reached 84% in Q4 2025, up 4 percentage points from the previous quarter, enhancing revenue predictability and customer base stability.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in contract share, indicating customer loyalty and improved predictability.

kpis.name: Aurora Class vessels delivered
kpis.explanation: Total number of new high-capacity vessels (7,000-9,500 CEU) commissioned to improve operational efficiency.
kpis.description: Seven Aurora Class vessels had been delivered by end-2025, including Höegh Starlight in December 2025, improving energy efficiency and reducing fleet carbon emissions.
kpis.signal: Fleet renewal with more efficient and lower-emission vessels.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents. Höegh Autoliners' strategy focuses on operational efficiency, fleet renewal, and sustainability.
evidence: No reference to AI or advanced automation technologies
Priority given to new Aurora Class vessels and emission reductions
Communication centered on volumes, freight rates, and customer contracts
